base_game_loop.summary: Rex Stampede: paid spin on 4x5. 1,024 to 5,184 ways to win. Bonus modes: Bonus, Super Bonus. Round ends on win cap if reached.

phases.name: Place bet and spin

phases.name: Initial symbol drop/spin
phases.what_happens: Symbols land on 4x5. Game-specific setup features may fire (birds, Nitro/COOL reels, collectors, etc.).
phases.ends_when: All symbols at resting positions / reels stopped

phases.name: Evaluate wins
phases.what_happens: Evaluate wins: 1,024 to 5,184 ways to win

phases.name: End-of-drop features
phases.what_happens: Resolve end-of-round features (bombs, mystery reveals, row swaps, boosters, etc.) if nothing else can happen; may resume avalanches.

phases.name: Bonus trigger check
phases.what_happens: If bonus/super-bonus trigger conditions met, enter bonus mode after resolving same-drop features. Otherwise settle base-game wins subject to win cap.

modes.name: Bonus
modes.trigger: 3 or more bonus symbols anywhere in view trigger the bonus game with Free Spins.
modes.effects:
ined in the game rules.
Three or more bonus symbols in Normal mode triggers the bonus game with Free Spins. If more than three bonus symbols land, more Free Spins are awarded. In the bonus game, the main feature is to collect golden T-Rex symbols. On reel 1, golden T-Rex symbols will increase the number of Free Spins. On reel 2 to 5, 3 collected golden T-Rex symbols will increase the reel to 6 rows. Then all symbols of the associated high value symbol type will be converted to T-Rex symbols on the reels.
Bet amount and balance are always displayed in the info bar at the bottom of the game view
modes.end_condition: bonus game ends when no Free Spins remain or when the win cap has been reached.

phases.name: Free drop/spin loop

phases.ends_when: No free drops/spins remain or win cap reached

phases.name: Settle
phases.what_happens: Pay bonus-mode winnings at end of bonus (or immediately on win cap).
